owner_calls.question: Season 1 is given as 12 episodes because it includes the two 1977 pilot movies ("The Incredible Hulk" and "A Death in the Family"). Wikipedia lists those as separate pilot movies and gives season 1 (1978) as 10 episodes. In the same Incursions box, The Amazing Spider-Man (1977) leaves out its pilot movie. Should the Hulk pilots stay in season 1?
options: Keep [12, 22, 23, 18, 7] with the pilots in season 1 (the DVD set convention)
Change to [10, 22, 23, 18, 7] and leave out the pilots, as with The Amazing Spider-Man (1977)
owner_calls.evidence: Wikipedia's series overview: pilot movies Nov 4 and Nov 28, 1977 (no season), season 1 episodes = 10, season 2 = 22, season 3 = 23, season 4 = 18, season 5 = 7. Every episode name and its order in the app otherwise match exactly.

Change to one season of 65 episodes in the same order
